question: How much is the Plus membership?
expectedAnswer: £39.99 per month, with unlimited haircuts and beard trims.

question: What's the difference between Plus and Premium?
expectedAnswer: Both have unlimited haircuts and beard trims; Premium (£69.99) also includes free add-ons, Plus (£39.99) charges £5 per add-on.

question: Does the Core plan include beard trims?
expectedAnswer: No. Core (£29.99/month) is haircuts only.

question: Where are you located?
expectedAnswer: Phenix Salon Suites, 1 Deansgate, Manchester, M3 1AZ, about 2 minutes from Manchester Arndale.

question: What time do you open on Saturdays?
expectedAnswer: Tuesday to Saturday, 11:00 to 21:00, so 11:00 on Saturday.

question: Are you open on Mondays?
expectedAnswer: No. Cut Labz is closed on Sunday and Monday.

question: Where can I park?
expectedAnswer: Several secure paid car parks within a 2-3 minute walk; no car park of its own.

question: How much notice do I need to cancel?
expectedAnswer: 24 hours. You can cancel or reschedule online until 24 hours before.

question: I need to cancel tomorrow morning, can I still do it online?
expectedAnswer: Not if it's within 24 hours. Contact the shop (phone/email); a £5 late fee applies under the terms.

question: What happens if I don't show up?
expectedAnswer: A £5 no-show fee; repeated no-shows may restrict access.

question: What if I'm running late to my appointment?
expectedAnswer: Arrive on time; late arrivals may mean reduced service time or rescheduling.

question: How much is a one-off haircut?
expectedAnswer: £20 for a haircut; £25 for haircut + beard.

question: How much are add-ons?
expectedAnswer: £5 each (hot towel, wash & dry, face mask/steam, hairline filler spray); free on Premium.

question: Do I need an account to book?
expectedAnswer: Yes, a free account is needed to book and to manage appointments.

question: How far in advance can I book?
expectedAnswer: Up to 28 days ahead, with at least 60 minutes' notice.

question: How long is a haircut appointment?
expectedAnswer: 30 minutes, add-ons don't add time. (Confirm this matches plans.md.)

question: Can I book two haircuts in the same week with my membership?
expectedAnswer: Not at the same time: members can hold one upcoming membership cut at a time; book the next after the first is done or cancelled.

question: Can I get a refund on my membership?
expectedAnswer: No. Memberships are non-refundable and there are no partial refunds; you can cancel any time and it stays active to the end of the billing cycle.

question: Who are the barbers?
expectedAnswer: Wayne Graham and Ayaan Ali; or choose Any available.

question: Can my brother use my membership?
expectedAnswer: No. Memberships are for personal use only.
